title: Cut loose from the band and drifting to New York
summary: The Raeburn years were fun with later knotted stomachs; Handy went home and then to New York, where trouble began.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Well you're being helpful to me. It's not easy to talk about those times, really. Those were very important times for me.
Looking back on it, were they fun times or were they real knotted stomach times?
They were fun times. There were some knotted stomachs though, later when it fell apart.
How did it feel when you were cut loose from what you must have known at that time was--if not the, surely a high point
To what band did I go?
Where did you go right then, that afternoon?
I went home and did whatever I would do normally.
Then what band did you go to?
I didn't go to any band; I came back to New York and got fouled up. It had started in California.
